questions.enonce: Comment traduit-on « Les consommateurs devraient essayer de réparer leurs appareils avant d'en acheter de nouveaux » ?
choix: Consumers should try to repair their devices before buying new ones.
Consumers should to try to repair their devices before to buy new ones.
Consumers should try repairing their devices before buy new.
Consumers must tries to repair their devices before buying new ones.
questions.explication: should + base verbale ; before + -ing ; new ones remplace le nom.
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 4 (traduction)

questions.enonce: Comment traduit-on « Quelles mesures le gouvernement a-t-il prises ces dernières années ? »
